description: A bearded man in a quilted black coat with gold embroidery and a tall ornate turban stands on the prow of a wooden boat, pointing toward a riverbank. On the bank, workers with stakes and cords and a few tents are laid out on bare earth, and smoke rises under a stormy sky. Other boats sit on the grey river, and a banner flies at the left edge. No text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.
